title: zero-gap evidence SIDECAR record (the chain file itself is the verifier-native JSONL; see data-model.md)

argv.description: argument vector as a JSON array of strings (upstream ExecRow.Argv is []string; the recorder writes an array; a joined string is forbidden by §11.4.115(H)(1))

stdout_digest.description: sha256 over the FULL stream, before truncation

chain_seq.description: LOAD-BEARING: MUST equal the `seq` of the chain record whose artifact_path binds this sidecar line; the adapter fails on any mismatch

independence_tier.description: supplied to the chain record (instance|model|capability per the constitution's independence_tier lib)

evidence_class.description: supplied to the chain record (runtime|artifact|source); distinct from population_kind

$comment: Invariant not expressible in JSON Schema: outcome 0 or 1 requires state_fingerprint_before == state_fingerprint_after; otherwise outcome MUST be 2. Enforced by the adapter and its Go/shell test. The verifier-native chain record has EXACTLY nine fields (seq, ts, command, exit_status, artifact_path, evidence_class, author_session_id, independence_tier, prev_digest), unknown fields are REFUSED, genesis prev_digest is the empty string, and artifact_path = "sha256:<hex of the exact sidecar line bytes>" binds the two files. The adapter MUST verify that binding itself (the verifier never reads the sidecar).
